title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 13: the reigns of Jehoahaz and Jehoash over Israel, the arrows at Elisha's deathbed and the man revived at Elisha's tomb.

questions.text: How long did Jehoahaz the son of Jehu reign over Israel in Samaria?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 13:1 says Jehoahaz began to reign over Israel in Samaria for seventeen years.

questions.text: Into whose hand did Yahweh deliver Israel when his anger burned against them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria and of Benhadad the son of Hazael, continually.

answers.text: The Philistines of Gath and Ashdod
Pharaoh king of Egypt and his army
The king of Assyria and his army
Hazael king of Syria and Benhadad his son

questions.text: What also remained in Samaria, even after Yahweh gave Israel a savior?
questions.explanation: The people didn't depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, and the Asherah also remained in Samaria.

questions.text: What did Joash king of Israel cry out as he wept over the sick Elisha?
questions.explanation: He wept over him and said, "My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!"

answers.text: "Man of God, do not leave me alone in this day of trouble!"
"Where is Yahweh, the God of Elijah, my father?"
"My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!"
"Let your spirit rest on me, my lord, before you die!"

questions.text: Which window did Elisha tell the king to open before he shot the arrow?
questions.explanation: Elisha said, "Open the window eastward," and he opened it.

questions.text: Where did Elisha say the king would strike the Syrians until he had consumed them?
questions.explanation: Elisha called it the arrow of victory over Syria and said, "You will strike the Syrians in Aphek, until you have consumed them."

questions.text: How many times did the king strike the ground with the arrows before he stopped?
questions.explanation: When told to strike the ground, he struck three times, and stopped.

questions.text: Whose bands invaded the land at the coming in of the year after Elisha died?
questions.explanation: After Elisha died and was buried, bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

questions.text: What happened when the dead man thrown into Elisha's tomb touched Elisha's bones?
questions.explanation: As soon as the man touched Elisha's bones, he revived and stood up on his feet.

answers.text: The tomb was filled with fire
He revived and stood up on his feet
The raiders fell to the ground

questions.text: Because of what did Yahweh have compassion on Israel and not destroy them yet?
questions.explanation: Yahweh was gracious to them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

answers.text: His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
